WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length
  FROM film
  WHERE length IS NOT NULL
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_length, b.avg_length AS baseline_length
  FROM rating_averages ra
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ra.avg_length > b.avg_length
),
kept AS (
  SELECT rating, avg_length, baseline_length,
         AVG(avg_length) OVER () AS kept_mean
  FROM above_baseline
)
SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS mean_rating_avg_length,
       AVG(avg_length - baseline_length) AS mean_excess_over_baseline,
       AVG(avg_length - kept_mean) AS mean_excess_over_kept_mean
FROM kept
WHERE avg_length > kept_mean
